entities.summary: Chen Tuan Chinese: 陳摶 was a Chinese Taoist credited with creation of the kung fu system Liuhebafa. Along with this internal art, he is also said to be associated with a method of qi (energy) cultivation known today as Taiji ruler and a 24-season Daoyin method using seated and standing exercises designed to prevent diseases that occur during seasonal changes throughout the year. Chen Tuan was a philosophers & thinkers from Luyi County (871-10-14, Luyi County–989-07-27). Holds notable historical significance, documented across 0 language editions of Wikipedia.
